WITH idle_starts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT timestamp AS start_time
  FROM process_metrics
  WHERE station_name = 'l2_buffer_b'
    AND metric_name = 'buffer_idle_time'
),
 
pre_scan_starts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT timestamp AS start_time
  FROM process_metrics
  WHERE station_name = 'l2_buffer_b'
    AND metric_name = 'buffer_holding_and_pre_stopper_down_time'
),
 
starts AS (
  SELECT start_time FROM idle_starts
  UNION
  SELECT p.start_time
  FROM pre_scan_starts p
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM idle_starts i
    WHERE i.start_time BETWEEN p.start_time - INTERVAL '10 seconds'
                           AND p.start_time + INTERVAL '10 seconds'
  )
),
 
ends AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT timestamp AS end_time
  FROM process_metrics
  WHERE station_name = 'l2_buffer_b'
    AND metric_name = 'buffer_pallet_release_and_pre_stopper_up_time'
),
 
cycle_pairs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.start_time)
    s.start_time,
    e.end_time
  FROM starts s
  JOIN ends e
    ON e.end_time > s.start_time
    AND e.end_time < s.start_time + INTERVAL '60 seconds'  -- max cycle guard
  ORDER BY s.start_time, e.end_time
)
 
SELECT
  start_time AS time,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (end_time - start_time)) AS cycle_time
FROM cycle_pairs
WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time)
ORDER BY start_time;

SELECT
  time,
  mean,
  upper_3sigma AS ucl,
  lower_3sigma AS lcl
FROM l2_buffer_b_cycle_nelson_view
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time;

SELECT
  time,
  anomaly_point AS anomaly
FROM l2_buffer_b_cycle_nelson_view
WHERE
  anomaly_point IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW l2_buffer_b_cycle_nelson_view AS

WITH idle_starts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT timestamp AS start_time
  FROM process_metrics
  WHERE station_name = 'l2_buffer_b'
    AND metric_name = 'buffer_idle_time'
),

pre_scan_starts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT timestamp AS start_time
  FROM process_metrics
  WHERE station_name = 'l2_buffer_b'
    AND metric_name = 'buffer_holding_and_pre_stopper_down_time'
),

starts AS (
  SELECT start_time FROM idle_starts
  UNION
  SELECT p.start_time
  FROM pre_scan_starts p
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM idle_starts i
    WHERE i.start_time BETWEEN p.start_time - INTERVAL '10 seconds'
                          AND p.start_time + INTERVAL '10 seconds'
  )
),

ends AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT timestamp AS end_time
  FROM process_metrics
  WHERE station_name = 'l2_buffer_b'
    AND metric_name = 'buffer_pallet_release_and_pre_stopper_up_time'
),

cycle_pairs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.start_time)
    s.start_time,
    e.end_time
  FROM starts s
  JOIN ends e
    ON e.end_time > s.start_time
   AND e.end_time < s.start_time + INTERVAL '60 seconds'
  ORDER BY s.start_time, e.end_time
),

cycle_time_calc AS (
  SELECT
    start_time AS time,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (end_time - start_time)) AS value
  FROM cycle_pairs
),

baseline AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(mean) AS mean,
    SQRT(SUM(std_dev * std_dev)) AS std
  FROM baseline_metrics
  WHERE station_name = 'l2_buffer_b'
    AND metric_name != 'buffer_idle_time'
),

ordered AS (
  SELECT
    ct.time,
    ct.value,
    b.mean,
    b.std,
    b.mean + (3 * b.std) AS upper_3sigma,
    b.mean - (3 * b.std) AS lower_3sigma,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ct.time) AS rn
  FROM cycle_time_calc ct
  CROSS JOIN baseline b
),

rules AS (
  SELECT *,
  
    (ABS(value - mean) > 3 * std) AS rule1_trigger,

    CASE WHEN
        (value > mean AND LAG(value,1) OVER w > mean AND LAG(value,2) OVER w > mean
         AND LAG(value,3) OVER w > mean AND LAG(value,4) OVER w > mean
         AND LAG(value,5) OVER w > mean AND LAG(value,6) OVER w > mean
         AND LAG(value,7) OVER w > mean AND LAG(value,8) OVER w > mean)
    OR  (value < mean AND LAG(value,1) OVER w < mean AND LAG(value,2) OVER w < mean
         AND LAG(value,3) OVER w < mean AND LAG(value,4) OVER w < mean
         AND LAG(value,5) OVER w < mean AND LAG(value,6) OVER w < mean
         AND LAG(value,7) OVER w < mean AND LAG(value,8) OVER w < mean)
    THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule2_trigger,

    CASE WHEN
        (value > LAG(value,1) OVER w AND LAG(value,1) OVER w > LAG(value,2) OVER w
         AND LAG(value,2) OVER w > LAG(value,3) OVER w AND LAG(value,3) OVER w > LAG(value,4) OVER w
         AND LAG(value,4) OVER w > LAG(value,5) OVER w)
    OR  (value < LAG(value,1) OVER w AND LAG(value,1) OVER w < LAG(value,2) OVER w
         AND LAG(value,2) OVER w < LAG(value,3) OVER w AND LAG(value,3) OVER w < LAG(value,4) OVER w
         AND LAG(value,4) OVER w < LAG(value,5) OVER w)
    THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule3_trigger,

    FALSE AS rule4_trigger,

    CASE WHEN
        (CASE WHEN value > mean + 2*std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
         CASE WHEN LAG(value,1) OVER w > mean + 2*std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
         CASE WHEN LAG(value,2) OVER w > mean + 2*std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2
    OR  (CASE WHEN value < mean - 2*std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
         CASE WHEN LAG(value,1) OVER w < mean - 2*std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
         CASE WHEN LAG(value,2) OVER w < mean - 2*std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2
    THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule5_trigger,

    CASE WHEN
        (CASE WHEN value > mean + std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
         CASE WHEN LAG(value,1) OVER w > mean + std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
         CASE WHEN LAG(value,2) OVER w > mean + std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
         CASE WHEN LAG(value,3) OVER w > mean + std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
         CASE WHEN LAG(value,4) OVER w > mean + std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4
    OR  (CASE WHEN value < mean - std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
         CASE WHEN LAG(value,1) OVER w < mean - std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
         CASE WHEN LAG(value,2) OVER w < mean - std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
         CASE WHEN LAG(value,3) OVER w < mean - std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
         CASE WHEN LAG(value,4) OVER w < mean - std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4
    THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule6_trigger,

    FALSE AS rule7_trigger,

    CASE WHEN
        ABS(value - mean) > std AND
        ABS(LAG(value,1) OVER w - mean) > std AND
        ABS(LAG(value,2) OVER w - mean) > std AND
        ABS(LAG(value,3) OVER w - mean) > std AND
        ABS(LAG(value,4) OVER w - mean) > std AND
        ABS(LAG(value,5) OVER w - mean) > std AND
        ABS(LAG(value,6) OVER w - mean) > std AND
        ABS(LAG(value,7) OVER w - mean) > std
    THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule8_trigger

  FROM ordered
  WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY rn)
),

backfilled AS (
  SELECT *,
      rule1_trigger AS rule1,
      CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN rule2_trigger THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
           OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 8 FOLLOWING) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule2,
      CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN rule3_trigger THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
           OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 5 FOLLOWING) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule3,
      FALSE AS rule4,
      CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN rule5_trigger THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
           OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule5,
      CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN rule6_trigger THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
           OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 4 FOLLOWING) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule6,
      FALSE AS rule7,
      CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN rule8_trigger THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
           OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 7 FOLLOWING) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule8
  FROM rules
),

final AS (
  SELECT *,
      (rule1 OR rule2 OR rule3 OR rule4 OR rule5 OR rule6 OR rule7 OR rule8) AS any_violation
  FROM backfilled
)

SELECT
  time,
  value,
  mean,
  upper_3sigma,
  lower_3sigma,
  any_violation,
  rule1, rule2, rule3, rule4, rule5, rule6, rule7, rule8,
  CASE WHEN any_violation THEN value ELSE NULL END AS anomaly_point,
  CONCAT_WS(' | ',
      CASE WHEN rule1 THEN 'Extreme Outlier Detected' END,
      CASE WHEN rule2 THEN 'Process Shift Detected' END,
      CASE WHEN rule3 THEN 'Process Drift Detected' END,
      CASE WHEN rule5 THEN 'Early Warning: Shift Developing' END,
      CASE WHEN rule6 THEN 'Gradual Drift Detected' END,
      CASE WHEN rule8 THEN 'High Variability Detected' END
  ) AS violated_rules
FROM final
ORDER BY time;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT time, value
  FROM l2_buffer_b_cycle_nelson_view
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
),
rolling AS (
  SELECT
    time,
    AVG(value)         OVER w AS rolling_mean,
    STDDEV_SAMP(value) OVER w AS rolling_std
  FROM base
  WINDOW w AS (
    ORDER BY time RANGE BETWEEN
    CASE '${rolling_window}'
      WHEN '1m'  THEN INTERVAL '1 minute'
      WHEN '5m'  THEN INTERVAL '5 minutes'
      WHEN '10m' THEN INTERVAL '10 minutes'
      WHEN '15m' THEN INTERVAL '15 minutes'
      WHEN '30m' THEN INTERVAL '30 minutes'
      WHEN '1h'  THEN INTERVAL '1 hour'
    END PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  )
)
SELECT
  time,
  rolling_mean,
  rolling_mean + 3 * rolling_std AS bb_upper,
  rolling_mean - 3 * rolling_std AS bb_lower
FROM rolling
ORDER BY time;

SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  value
FROM process_metrics
WHERE 
  metric_name = 'buffer_idle_time'
  AND station_name = 'l2_buffer_b'
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp;

SELECT
  time,
  mean,
  upper_3sigma,
  lower_3sigma,
  anomaly_point
FROM l2_buffer_b_buffer_idle_time_view 
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)

DROP VIEW IF EXISTS l2_buffer_b_buffer_idle_time_view;
CREATE VIEW l2_buffer_b_buffer_idle_time_view AS
WITH ordered AS (
    SELECT
        pm.timestamp AS time, pm.value,
        bm.mean, bm.std_dev AS std,
        bm.mean + (3 * bm.std_dev) AS upper_3sigma,
        bm.mean - (3 * bm.std_dev) AS lower_3sigma,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pm.timestamp) AS rn
    FROM public.process_metrics pm
    JOIN public.baseline_metrics bm
      ON bm.station_name = pm.station_name AND bm.metric_name = pm.metric_name
    WHERE pm.station_name = 'l2_buffer_b'
      AND pm.metric_name = 'buffer_idle_time'
),
rules AS (
    SELECT *,
        -- Rule 1: single point beyond 3σ
        (ABS(value - mean) > 3 * std) AS rule1_trigger,
 
        -- Rule 2: 9 consecutive same side
        CASE WHEN
            (value > mean AND LAG(value,1) OVER w > mean AND LAG(value,2) OVER w > mean
             AND LAG(value,3) OVER w > mean AND LAG(value,4) OVER w > mean
             AND LAG(value,5) OVER w > mean AND LAG(value,6) OVER w > mean
             AND LAG(value,7) OVER w > mean AND LAG(value,8) OVER w > mean)
        OR  (value < mean AND LAG(value,1) OVER w < mean AND LAG(value,2) OVER w < mean
             AND LAG(value,3) OVER w < mean AND LAG(value,4) OVER w < mean
             AND LAG(value,5) OVER w < mean AND LAG(value,6) OVER w < mean
             AND LAG(value,7) OVER w < mean AND LAG(value,8) OVER w < mean)
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule2_trigger,
 
        -- Rule 3: 6 consecutive trending
        CASE WHEN
            (value > LAG(value,1) OVER w AND LAG(value,1) OVER w > LAG(value,2) OVER w
             AND LAG(value,2) OVER w > LAG(value,3) OVER w AND LAG(value,3) OVER w > LAG(value,4) OVER w
             AND LAG(value,4) OVER w > LAG(value,5) OVER w)
        OR  (value < LAG(value,1) OVER w AND LAG(value,1) OVER w < LAG(value,2) OVER w
             AND LAG(value,2) OVER w < LAG(value,3) OVER w AND LAG(value,3) OVER w < LAG(value,4) OVER w
             AND LAG(value,4) OVER w < LAG(value,5) OVER w)
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule3_trigger,
 
        -- Rule 4: DISABLED
        FALSE AS rule4_trigger,
 
        -- Rule 5: 2 of 3 beyond 2σ same side
        CASE WHEN
            (CASE WHEN value > mean + 2*std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,1) OVER w > mean + 2*std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,2) OVER w > mean + 2*std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2
        OR  (CASE WHEN value < mean - 2*std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,1) OVER w < mean - 2*std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,2) OVER w < mean - 2*std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule5_trigger,
 
        -- Rule 6: 4 of 5 beyond 1σ same side
        CASE WHEN
            (CASE WHEN value > mean + std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,1) OVER w > mean + std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,2) OVER w > mean + std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,3) OVER w > mean + std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,4) OVER w > mean + std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4
        OR  (CASE WHEN value < mean - std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,1) OVER w < mean - std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,2) OVER w < mean - std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,3) OVER w < mean - std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,4) OVER w < mean - std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule6_trigger,
 
        -- Rule 7: DISABLED
        FALSE AS rule7_trigger,
 
        -- Rule 8: 8 consecutive beyond 1σ either side
        CASE WHEN
            ABS(value - mean) > std AND ABS(LAG(value,1) OVER w - mean) > std AND
            ABS(LAG(value,2) OVER w - mean) > std AND ABS(LAG(value,3) OVER w - mean) > std AND
            ABS(LAG(value,4) OVER w - mean) > std AND ABS(LAG(value,5) OVER w - mean) > std AND
            ABS(LAG(value,6) OVER w - mean) > std AND ABS(LAG(value,7) OVER w - mean) > std
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule8_trigger
    FROM ordered WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY rn)
),
backfilled AS (
    SELECT *,
        rule1_trigger AS rule1,
        CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN rule2_trigger THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 8 FOLLOWING) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule2,
        CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN rule3_trigger THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 5 FOLLOWING) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule3,
        FALSE AS rule4,
        CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN rule5_trigger THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule5,
        CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN rule6_trigger THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 4 FOLLOWING) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule6,
        FALSE AS rule7,
        CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN rule8_trigger THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 7 FOLLOWING) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule8
    FROM rules
),
final AS (
    SELECT *, (rule1 OR rule2 OR rule3 OR rule4 OR rule5 OR rule6 OR rule7 OR rule8) AS any_violation
    FROM backfilled
)
SELECT
    time, value, mean, upper_3sigma, lower_3sigma,
    CASE WHEN any_violation THEN value ELSE NULL END AS anomaly_point,
    CONCAT_WS(' | ',
        CASE WHEN rule1 THEN 'Extreme Outlier Detected' END,
        CASE WHEN rule2 THEN 'Process Shift Detected' END,
        CASE WHEN rule3 THEN 'Process Drift Detected' END,
        CASE WHEN rule4 THEN 'Unstable Oscillation Detected' END,
        CASE WHEN rule5 THEN 'Early Warning: Shift Developing' END,
        CASE WHEN rule6 THEN 'Gradual Drift Detected' END,
        CASE WHEN rule7 THEN 'Abnormal Stability Detected' END,
        CASE WHEN rule8 THEN 'High Variability Detected' END
    ) AS rule_description
FROM final
ORDER BY time;

WITH base AS (

DROP VIEW IF EXISTS l2_buffer_b_buffer_holding_time_view;
CREATE VIEW l2_buffer_b_buffer_holding_time_view AS
WITH ordered AS (
    SELECT
        pm.timestamp AS time, pm.value,
        bm.mean, bm.std_dev AS std,
        bm.mean + (3 * bm.std_dev) AS upper_3sigma,
        bm.mean - (3 * bm.std_dev) AS lower_3sigma,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pm.timestamp) AS rn
    FROM public.process_metrics pm
    JOIN public.baseline_metrics bm
      ON bm.station_name = pm.station_name AND bm.metric_name = pm.metric_name
    WHERE pm.station_name = 'l2_buffer_b'
      AND pm.metric_name = 'buffer_holding_and_pre_stopper_down_time'
),
rules AS (
    SELECT *,
        -- Rule 1: single point beyond 3σ
        (ABS(value - mean) > 3 * std) AS rule1_trigger,
 
        -- Rule 2: 9 consecutive same side
        CASE WHEN
            (value > mean AND LAG(value,1) OVER w > mean AND LAG(value,2) OVER w > mean
             AND LAG(value,3) OVER w > mean AND LAG(value,4) OVER w > mean
             AND LAG(value,5) OVER w > mean AND LAG(value,6) OVER w > mean
             AND LAG(value,7) OVER w > mean AND LAG(value,8) OVER w > mean)
        OR  (value < mean AND LAG(value,1) OVER w < mean AND LAG(value,2) OVER w < mean
             AND LAG(value,3) OVER w < mean AND LAG(value,4) OVER w < mean
             AND LAG(value,5) OVER w < mean AND LAG(value,6) OVER w < mean
             AND LAG(value,7) OVER w < mean AND LAG(value,8) OVER w < mean)
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule2_trigger,
 
        -- Rule 3: 6 consecutive trending
        CASE WHEN
            (value > LAG(value,1) OVER w AND LAG(value,1) OVER w > LAG(value,2) OVER w
             AND LAG(value,2) OVER w > LAG(value,3) OVER w AND LAG(value,3) OVER w > LAG(value,4) OVER w
             AND LAG(value,4) OVER w > LAG(value,5) OVER w)
        OR  (value < LAG(value,1) OVER w AND LAG(value,1) OVER w < LAG(value,2) OVER w
             AND LAG(value,2) OVER w < LAG(value,3) OVER w AND LAG(value,3) OVER w < LAG(value,4) OVER w
             AND LAG(value,4) OVER w < LAG(value,5) OVER w)
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule3_trigger,
 
        -- Rule 4: DISABLED
        FALSE AS rule4_trigger,
 
        -- Rule 5: 2 of 3 beyond 2σ same side
        CASE WHEN
            (CASE WHEN value > mean + 2*std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,1) OVER w > mean + 2*std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,2) OVER w > mean + 2*std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2
        OR  (CASE WHEN value < mean - 2*std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,1) OVER w < mean - 2*std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,2) OVER w < mean - 2*std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule5_trigger,
 
        -- Rule 6: 4 of 5 beyond 1σ same side
        CASE WHEN
            (CASE WHEN value > mean + std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,1) OVER w > mean + std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,2) OVER w > mean + std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,3) OVER w > mean + std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,4) OVER w > mean + std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4
        OR  (CASE WHEN value < mean - std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,1) OVER w < mean - std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,2) OVER w < mean - std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,3) OVER w < mean - std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,4) OVER w < mean - std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule6_trigger,
 
        -- Rule 7: DISABLED
        FALSE AS rule7_trigger,
 
        -- Rule 8: 8 consecutive beyond 1σ either side
        CASE WHEN
            ABS(value - mean) > std AND ABS(LAG(value,1) OVER w - mean) > std AND
            ABS(LAG(value,2) OVER w - mean) > std AND ABS(LAG(value,3) OVER w - mean) > std AND
            ABS(LAG(value,4) OVER w - mean) > std AND ABS(LAG(value,5) OVER w - mean) > std AND
            ABS(LAG(value,6) OVER w - mean) > std AND ABS(LAG(value,7) OVER w - mean) > std
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule8_trigger
    FROM ordered WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY rn)
),
backfilled AS (
    SELECT *,
        rule1_trigger AS rule1,
        CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN rule2_trigger THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 8 FOLLOWING) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule2,
        CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN rule3_trigger THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 5 FOLLOWING) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule3,
        FALSE AS rule4,
        CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN rule5_trigger THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule5,
        CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN rule6_trigger THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 4 FOLLOWING) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule6,

    CONCAT_WS(' | ',

        CASE WHEN rule2 THEN 'Process Shift Detected' END,
        CASE WHEN rule3 THEN 'Process Drift Detected' END,
        CASE WHEN rule4 THEN 'Unstable Oscillation Detected' END,
        CASE WHEN rule5 THEN 'Early Warning: Shift Developing' END,
        CASE WHEN rule6 THEN 'Gradual Drift Detected' END,
        CASE WHEN rule7 THEN 'Abnormal Stability Detected' END,
        CASE WHEN rule8 THEN 'High Variability Detected' END
    ) AS rule_description
FROM final
ORDER BY time;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT timestamp AS time, value
  FROM process_metrics
  WHERE metric_name = 'buffer_holding_and_pre_stopper_down_time'
    AND station_name = 'l2_buffer_b'
    AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
),
rolling AS (
  SELECT
    time,
    AVG(value)         OVER w AS rolling_mean,
    STDDEV_SAMP(value) OVER w AS rolling_std
  FROM base
  WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY time RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '${rolling_window}' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
)
SELECT
  time,
  rolling_mean,
  rolling_mean + 3 * rolling_std AS bb_upper,
  rolling_mean - 3 * rolling_std AS bb_lower
FROM rolling

DROP VIEW IF EXISTS public.l2_buffer_b_buffer_pallet_release_time_view;
CREATE VIEW public.l2_buffer_b_buffer_pallet_release_time_view AS
WITH ordered AS (
    SELECT
        pm.timestamp AS time, pm.value,
        bm.mean, bm.std_dev AS std,
        bm.mean + (3 * bm.std_dev) AS upper_3sigma,
        bm.mean - (3 * bm.std_dev) AS lower_3sigma,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pm.timestamp) AS rn
    FROM public.process_metrics pm
    JOIN public.baseline_metrics bm
      ON bm.station_name = pm.station_name AND bm.metric_name = pm.metric_name
    WHERE pm.station_name = 'l2_buffer_b'
      AND pm.metric_name = 'buffer_pallet_release_and_pre_stopper_up_time'
),
rules AS (
    SELECT *,
        -- Rule 1: single point beyond 3σ
        (ABS(value - mean) > 3 * std) AS rule1_trigger,
 
        -- Rule 2: 9 consecutive same side
        CASE WHEN
            (value > mean AND LAG(value,1) OVER w > mean AND LAG(value,2) OVER w > mean
             AND LAG(value,3) OVER w > mean AND LAG(value,4) OVER w > mean
             AND LAG(value,5) OVER w > mean AND LAG(value,6) OVER w > mean
             AND LAG(value,7) OVER w > mean AND LAG(value,8) OVER w > mean)
        OR  (value < mean AND LAG(value,1) OVER w < mean AND LAG(value,2) OVER w < mean
             AND LAG(value,3) OVER w < mean AND LAG(value,4) OVER w < mean
             AND LAG(value,5) OVER w < mean AND LAG(value,6) OVER w < mean
             AND LAG(value,7) OVER w < mean AND LAG(value,8) OVER w < mean)
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule2_trigger,
 
        -- Rule 3: 6 consecutive trending
        CASE WHEN
            (value > LAG(value,1) OVER w AND LAG(value,1) OVER w > LAG(value,2) OVER w
             AND LAG(value,2) OVER w > LAG(value,3) OVER w AND LAG(value,3) OVER w > LAG(value,4) OVER w
             AND LAG(value,4) OVER w > LAG(value,5) OVER w)
        OR  (value < LAG(value,1) OVER w AND LAG(value,1) OVER w < LAG(value,2) OVER w
             AND LAG(value,2) OVER w < LAG(value,3) OVER w AND LAG(value,3) OVER w < LAG(value,4) OVER w
             AND LAG(value,4) OVER w < LAG(value,5) OVER w)
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule3_trigger,
 
        -- Rule 4: DISABLED
        FALSE AS rule4_trigger,
 
        -- Rule 5: 2 of 3 beyond 2σ same side
        CASE WHEN
            (CASE WHEN value > mean + 2*std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,1) OVER w > mean + 2*std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,2) OVER w > mean + 2*std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2
        OR  (CASE WHEN value < mean - 2*std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,1) OVER w < mean - 2*std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,2) OVER w < mean - 2*std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule5_trigger,
 
        -- Rule 6: 4 of 5 beyond 1σ same side
        CASE WHEN
            (CASE WHEN value > mean + std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,1) OVER w > mean + std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,2) OVER w > mean + std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,3) OVER w > mean + std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,4) OVER w > mean + std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4
        OR  (CASE WHEN value < mean - std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,1) OVER w < mean - std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,2) OVER w < mean - std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,3) OVER w < mean - std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,4) OVER w < mean - std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule6_trigger,
 
        -- Rule 7: DISABLED
        FALSE AS rule7_trigger,
 
        -- Rule 8: 8 consecutive beyond 1σ either side
        CASE WHEN
            ABS(value - mean) > std AND ABS(LAG(value,1) OVER w - mean) > std AND
            ABS(LAG(value,2) OVER w - mean) > std AND ABS(LAG(value,3) OVER w - mean) > std AND
            ABS(LAG(value,4) OVER w - mean) > std AND ABS(LAG(value,5) OVER w - mean) > std AND
            ABS(LAG(value,6) OVER w - mean) > std AND ABS(LAG(value,7) OVER w - mean) > std
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule8_trigger
    FROM ordered WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY rn)
),
backfilled AS (
    SELECT *,
        rule1_trigger AS rule1,
        CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN rule2_trigger THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 8 FOLLOWING) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule2,
        CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN rule3_trigger THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 5 FOLLOWING) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule3,
        FALSE AS rule4,
        CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN rule5_trigger THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule5,
        CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN rule6_trigger THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 4 FOLLOWING) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule6,
        FALSE AS rule7,
        CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN rule8_trigger THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 7 FOLLOWING) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule8
    FROM rules
),
final AS (
    SELECT *, (rule1 OR rule2 OR rule3 OR rule4 OR rule5 OR rule6 OR rule7 OR rule8) AS any_violation FROM backfilled
)
SELECT time, value, mean, upper_3sigma, lower_3sigma,
    CASE WHEN any_violation THEN value ELSE NULL END AS anomaly_point,
    CASE WHEN any_violation THEN CONCAT_WS(' | ',
        CASE WHEN rule1 THEN 'Extreme Outlier Detected' END,
        CASE WHEN rule2 THEN 'Process Shift Detected' END,
        CASE WHEN rule3 THEN 'Process Drift Detected' END,
        CASE WHEN rule4 THEN 'Unstable Oscillation Detected' END,
        CASE WHEN rule5 THEN 'Early Warning: Shift Developing' END,
        CASE WHEN rule6 THEN 'Gradual Drift Detected' END,
        CASE WHEN rule7 THEN 'Abnormal Stability Detected' END,
        CASE WHEN rule8 THEN 'High Variability Detected' END
    ) ELSE '' END AS rule_description
FROM final ORDER BY time;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT timestamp AS time, value
  FROM process_metrics
  WHERE metric_name = 'buffer_pallet_release_and_pre_stopper_up_time'
    AND station_name = 'l2_buffer_b'
    AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
),
rolling AS (
  SELECT
    time,

    STDDEV_SAMP(value) OVER w AS rolling_std
  FROM base
  WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY time RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '${rolling_window}' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
)
SELECT

  rolling_mean + 3 * rolling_std AS bb_upper,
  rolling_mean - 3 * rolling_std AS bb_lower
FROM rolling
ORDER BY time;
